meta.descripcion: Diagnosis, repair, and rebuilding of manual and automatic Porsche gearboxes, ranging from 356 to the 991 and 992 generations.

parrafos: We repair and rebuild all of the brand's gearboxes: the 356, 915, and G50 models, as well as later versions up to the 991 and 992. We also service automatic units,transmissions that are often deemed beyond repair, though rarely are.
Rebuilding a gearbox is almost always a better option than replacing it; for classic cars, it is also the only way to preserve the correct serial numbers.

The gearbox is opened, measured, and cataloged piece by piece. Synchronizers, shift forks, bearings, and seals are evaluated individually, and the cost estimate is prepared based on this itemized list. In vehicles where the gearbox is mated to the engine, both components are removed as a single unit and serviced simultaneously.

parrafos: The Magazine shows the work and its photographs in this documented case.

A gearbox must be diagnosed based on its architecture and the precise moment a symptom appears, rather than just the general driving feel. That is why our initial conversation focuses not on a service menu, but on the car, its history, and the owner's expectations.

The assessment considers noise, the affected gear, temperature, load, oil history, leaks, the shift mechanism, the clutch, and performance when cold versus hot. If information is missing, we specify the necessary checks to obtain it before turning a hypothesis into a price quote.

The scope of work is determined proportionally: we service Porsche manual and automatic transmissions,ranging from the 356, 915, and G50 models up to the 991 and 992 generations, including the Tiptronic and PDK, depending on the specific unit. Tasks are sequenced to avoid redundant disassembly, prevent masking symptoms, and avoid replacing an entire assembly when it can still be diagnosed or repaired.

Technical decisions are based on the following criteria: synchronizers, bearings, shift forks, seals, the differential, the clutch, and control mechanisms are evaluated individually. For automatic transmissions, the control system, hydraulics, and mechanical components are also assessed separately. If a finding alters the scope of the initial request, that specific issue is separated from the approved work and explained before proceeding.

secciones.titulo: What the owner receives after Gearboxes
parrafos: The deliverable consists of a report on findings and parts, a defined scope of work, and a reassembled, tested gearbox,avoiding the default approach of simply replacing the entire unit. The final explanation ensures an understanding of the work performed, the reasons behind it, and any subsequent observations or maintenance scheduling required.

We also outline the limitations of the work. An inspection describes the observed condition; maintenance does not, in itself, fix a breakdown; and a restoration should not be considered complete until the car has been tested as a whole.

secciones.titulo: How to prepare for the initial consultation: Gearboxes
parrafos: To make the most of the consultation, it is helpful to provide the model, version, year, chassis number (where relevant), and any available history. If there is a specific symptom, it is useful to describe when it occurs,such as whether the engine is cold or hot, or if the issue arises under load or during deceleration,and whether the behavior has changed recently.

Past invoices, photographs, and diagnostic reports help avoid redundant work, though they do not replace a current inspection. This information determines whether an inspection appointment suffices, whether the car needs to be transported to the shop, or if only the specific component needs to be sent in.

Depending on the car's condition and the desired outcome, the work can be coordinated with engine services, maintenance, or pre-purchase inspection. Each page outlines the specific scope of work prior to booking an appointment.
These answers help prepare for your consultation. Final recommendations depend on the specific vehicle and available evidence.

secciones.titulo: Are all gear-selection issues caused by the gearbox itself?
parrafos: No. Linkage, the clutch, mounts, or adjustments can cause similar symptoms. These components are checked before concluding that the gearbox needs to be opened.
In addition to restoring functionality, it allows for the preservation of the original unit linked to the car,important when matching serial numbers and original configurations matter.
